summary: Tested new Communication staff dashboard (2-step auth + 7 tabs) and Secretary teacher edit/delete under RH → Professeurs. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed in test_communication_and_secretary.py covering /api/auth/login (admin/secretary/communication), /api/communication/{stats, set-availability, my-availability, balance, notes CRUD, leaves, payments (admin), payments/status}, and /api/admin/{all-teachers-detailed, update-user, delete-user} incl. secretary permissions and admin-modify protection. Frontend: Communication user logs in with COMKALAMA, personal-code modal accepts MBM, dashboard renders header + 5 stat cards + all 7 expected tabs (Actualités, Disponibilités, Soldes, Messages, Notes, Congés, Kalamathèque); Soldes correctly shows pending 450€ + paid 250.5€ TEST_payment created via admin API. Secretary → RH → Professeurs shows Fiches Professeurs with Modifier and Supprimer buttons; Modifier opens a modal pre-filled with first_name/last_name/email/phone.

minor.issue: amount/hours are float()-coerced without validation. Negative/absurd values are accepted; add Pydantic model with amount >= 0, hours >= 0.

com_code from body is trusted for the communication role. A logged-in communication user can post data as ANY code (MBM or FZT). Server should either verify the logged-in user is that code, or bind com_code to the user record instead of body input.

No email uniqueness check when updating - a secretary could change teacher A's email to match teacher B's email, breaking login. Also 'level' & 'is_active' are updatable by secretary; if unintended, restrict allowed_fields per role.
No auth/role guard beyond current_user Depends - any authenticated user can mark any message as read (no ownership check).

issues: No data-testid attributes on tabs, buttons or inputs. Testing must rely on visible French labels which collide with stat-card labels (e.g. 'Congés' matches both the tab and the stat card). Recommend adding data-testid to TabsTrigger, personal-code input, Accéder button, stat cards.
Modifier/Supprimer buttons and edit modal inputs lack data-testid. Both accented labels ('Ancienneté', 'Non renseigné') now render correctly - previous iteration_13 issue is fixed.

action_items: Add Pydantic validation on POST /api/communication/payments (amount >= 0, hours >= 0, valid status enum).
Bind com_code to the authenticated communication user (or verify body com_code == user.com_code) on notes/leaves/set-availability POSTs so one Chargé de Com cannot post as the other.
Add email-uniqueness check in PUT /api/admin/update-user/{user_id}. Optionally restrict secretary from editing 'level' and 'is_active'.
Add data-testid attributes on CommunicationDashboard tabs/inputs/buttons and on SecretaryHR teacher edit/delete controls for reliable automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: communication.py trusts com_code from request body for role='communication' — real authorization bug (privilege between MBM and FZT).
admin.py update-user allows secretary to update 'is_active' and 'level' — verify this is intended (probably OK for level, but is_active can disable accounts).
CommunicationDashboard.js is 934 lines — approaching split threshold; extract each tab into its own component.
Repeat: SecretaryDashboard.js remains >2000 lines (flagged in iteration_13, still unfixed).
communication.py: payments amount coerced with float(data.get('amount', 0)) — no bounds check, allowing negative payments.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used: admin@mykalamaenglish.com/adminco, secretaire@mykalamaenglish.com/kalamasecret, com@mykalamaenglish.com/COMKALAMA (code MBM).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ payment for MBM (Janvier 2026, 250.5€ then marked paid), TEST_Note (deleted in-test), TEST_conge leave (pending, not cleaned), and one TESTteach<ts>.autotest teacher which was created + edited + soft-deleted during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 requested features work end-to-end. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_communication_and_secretary.py covers auth + communication CRUD + secretary teacher update/delete. Known unresolved (not blockers): (1) com_code trust from body across communication endpoints, (2) no email-uniqueness in admin update-user, (3) payments amount not validated, (4) missing data-testid across CommunicationDashboard and SecretaryHR — will make future UI automation flaky (had to fall back to French text selectors, which collide with stat-card labels).
